signalValue.note: Listed on FutureCast early target board

vaultScouting.evaluation: Craig-James is a long 6-3 / 185 safety. On the Parker sophomore sit he ranges the deep ball for a pick, closes the out, and dives on another interception. Tackling is still a little high.
vaultScouting.comparison: Craig-James comps to Jeremy Chinn — 6-3 / 220 long safety who can play single-high, close the alley, and still get his hands on the ball.
vaultScouting.projection: Craig-James projects as a Year 1 special-teams safety, then a Year 2 rotation piece, with Year 3 starter upside at single-high if he adds mass and stays in phase.
strengths: Craig-James covers ground from the hash to the sideline and intercepts the deep ball without breaking stride.
Craig-James drives from off coverage, closes the out, and hits the catch point on time.
Craig-James reads the out, dives, and finishes the interception with the ball away from his body.
Craig-James fills the alley downhill and squares the runner instead of grabbing high and hoping.
vaultScouting.schemeFit: Craig-James fits a long single-high / two-high safety who can range the deep ball and fill the run.
